# A Fixture Paper on Citations

## Introduction

Paradigms shift when anomalies accumulate [@kuhn1962]. Lending follows growth [@lindqvist2012]. The same shift recurs [@kuhn1962].

Several studies agree [@lindqvist2012; @okafor2019]. Trust can be measured [@okafor2019, p. 40]. Networks persist [@okafor2019 41].

## Discussion

@lindqvist2012 argue that lending policy follows growth.

## Punctuation and Locators

Anomalies pile up [@kuhn1962]... Is lending growth-led [@lindqvist2012]?! Kuhn wrote of "the essential tension" [@kuhn1962]. He asked "is it a paradigm?" [@kuhn1962]. Lending stalls (in some years [@lindqvist2012]).

The pages are cited as a range [@okafor2019, 33--38], an open run [@okafor2019, 33ff.]. A chapter [@kuhn1962, chap. 2] and a section [@kuhn1962, sec. 3].
